items.headline: Series A closes at $3.5B valuation; capacity ramp to 200+ MW by 2027
items.summary: G announced a $350M Series A valuing it at $3.5B, citing scale-out from 54MW to 200+MW in 2027 and 13 data centers. Round plus megawatt ramp is strong capacity evidence.
